title: ⏰ My schedule bows to my calling—not the algorithm.
paragraphs:
⏰ My schedule bows to my calling—not the algorithm.
When Heaven speaks, time kneels. If this hits your spirit, type “I’m choosing calling over noise.” 🙏🔥

Bible Verse (KJV)
“But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” — Matthew 6:33
